dap-001.title: dap-001 The CapabilityStatement declares DocumentReference and Binary
dap-001.expected: No fixture or token required. The live server must declare the capabilities named by the assertions.

dap-002.title: dap-002 The CapabilityStatement declares SMART on FHIR security
dap-002.expected: No fixture or token required. The live server must declare the capabilities named by the assertions.

dap-003.title: dap-003 A request without a token is refused
dap-003.expected: Reject the request with the status in the assertions. Authorization and scope configuration are external prerequisites, not fixture resources.

dap-004.title: dap-004 A token with no usable scope is refused
dap-004.expected: Reject the request with the status in the assertions. Authorization and scope configuration are external prerequisites, not fixture resources.

dap-005.title: dap-005 Search by patient returns a searchset of conformant DocumentReferences
assertions: $found at "Bundle.entry.resource.ofType(DocumentReference).all(status = 'current' or status = 'superseded' or status = 'entered-in-error')" should be true
dap-005.expected: The searches must include and exclude the fixture resources specified in searchChecks. Extra unrelated server data is allowed only if it matches the query.

dap-006.title: dap-006 Search by EEHRxF priority category
dap-006.expected: The searches must include and exclude the fixture resources specified in searchChecks. Extra unrelated server data is allowed only if it matches the query.

dap-007.title: dap-007 Search by LOINC document type
assertions: $byType at "Bundle.entry.resource.ofType(DocumentReference).all(type.coding.where(system='http://loinc.org' and code='60591-5').exists())" should be true
dap-007.expected: The searches must include and exclude the fixture resources specified in searchChecks. Extra unrelated server data is allowed only if it matches the query.

dap-008.title: dap-008 Read a DocumentReference by id
dap-008.expected: Read the bound target DocumentReference: current, type 60591-5, category Patient-Summaries, subject target patient and attachment URL pointing to the target Binary.

dap-009.title: dap-009 An unknown DocumentReference id gives 404 and an OperationOutcome
dap-009.expected: The reserved otb-no-such-* identifier in the feature must not exist; expect 404 and an OperationOutcome.

dap-010.title: dap-010 Read the document content as a Binary
dap-010.expected: Read the bound target Binary. Its content type is text/plain and decoded data matches the bundled synthetic target document.

dap-011.title: dap-011 Search Patient by identifier
assertions: $patients should conform to "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle" ignoring slicing errors
dap-011.expected: The searches must include and exclude the fixture resources specified in searchChecks. Extra unrelated server data is allowed only if it matches the query.

dap-012.title: dap-012 Read Patient by id and conform to patient-eu-core
assertions: $patient should conform to "http://hl7.eu/fhir/base/StructureDefinition/patient-eu-core" ignoring slicing errors
dap-012.expected: Read the bound target patient: active, Synthetic EUAPITestpatient, gender unknown, birth date 1990-01-01, and the declared fixture identifier.

dap-013.title: dap-013 Search Patient by demographics the reference patient has
dap-013.expected: The searches must include and exclude the fixture resources specified in searchChecks. Extra unrelated server data is allowed only if it matches the query.

dap-014.title: dap-014 The CapabilityStatement declares create on DocumentReference

dap-015.title: dap-015 A Simplified Publish with embedded content is accepted and then findable
dap-015.expected: Create a new document for the bound target patient, return 201 and Location. This changes server state; the fixture search expectations are inclusion/exclusion checks, not global exact counts.

dap-016.title: dap-016 A submission without content is refused
dap-016.expected: Reject the malformed submission with 400 or 422. No invalid resource is preloaded.

dap-017.title: dap-017 A submission with a token that cannot create is refused
dap-017.expected: Reject the request with the status in the assertions. Authorization and scope configuration are external prerequisites, not fixture resources.
